scripts.dev:workspaces: npm run build -w @between/contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @between/api" "npm run dev -w @between/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @between/contracts && npm run build -w @between/web && npm run build -w @between/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @between/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @between/contracts && tsx --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts scripts/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.checkpoint:live: npm run build -w @between/contracts && node scripts/with-env.mjs scripts/live-checkpoint.mjs
